title: Open Values Register Entity Inventory
description: A list of every decision in the catalogue with how many options it has and a hash of their codes and names. A build script makes it from the dataset index, and the register mapping tools use it to notice when an option has been added, removed or renamed.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-register-entity-inventory.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

generatedFrom.description: The file this inventory was built from, with its hash, so a stale inventory can be detected.

index.description: The path of the dataset index the inventory was built from. Always app/data/index.json.

indexSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the index file's bytes at build time, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

decisions.description: How many built decisions are listed.

entities.description: How many options there are across all decisions.

missingCodes.description: How many options had no code. Always 0, because the build stops if any option lacks one.

missingNames.description: How many options had no name. Always 0, because the build stops if any option lacks one.

duplicateCodesWithinDecision.description: How many option codes were repeated inside one decision. Always 0, because the build stops on a repeat.

catalogueIdentitySha256.description: One SHA-256 hash over every decision's cid, entityCount and identitySha256. It changes whenever any option is added, removed, renamed or recoded anywhere in the catalogue.

decisions.description: One row per built decision, sorted by cid.

cid.description: The decision's id, as used in app/data/index.json.

label.description: The decision's display name, copied from the index.

dataset.description: The path of the decision's dataset file under app/data/.

entityField.description: Which array in the dataset holds the options: products or resources.

entityCount.description: How many options the decision has.

identitySha256.description: A SHA-256 hash of the decision's option codes and names, sorted by code. It changes when an option is added, removed, renamed or recoded, and mappings use it to notice that.
